description: Create and register a fresh agent wallet in one call, for MCP clients that cannot sign EIP-191 or solve proof of work. Returns wallet_address, a one-time private_key, referral_code and 2 free points (3 with an inviter code). The gateway never stores the key: save it if you will sign points payments later, and never fund this burner wallet.
name: register_a2a_agent
